title: Add CSV export to reporting module
description: Add an exportToCsv(rows, columns) capability to the reporting module so report data already available as an array of row objects can be downloaded as a correctly escaped CSV file, matching the column order and headers already defined for the on-screen report.
acceptanceCriteria: exportToCsv produces a header row matching the provided column definitions in order.
Field values containing commas, quotes, or newlines are correctly quoted/escaped per RFC 4180.
Empty or null field values render as empty CSV fields, not the string 'null' or 'undefined'.
The exported CSV round-trips through a standard CSV parser back into the original row data.
verificationMethod: test-suite: run the new CSV export unit tests, including RFC 4180 special-character cases and a round-trip parse test.
groundTruth: A correct implementation escapes any field containing a comma, quote, or newline by wrapping it in double quotes and doubling internal quotes, joining fields with commas and rows consistently with CRLF or LF.
